name: follow-up-source-check
cmd: set -euo pipefail; cp -a audit-data/follow-up-input/. .; mkdir -p current-audit/source; cp followup-source/*.ts current-audit/source/; cp audit-data/resource-run.ts current-audit/; cp followup-source/validate-tools.ts current-audit/; bun -e 'import{readdirSync,readFileSync,writeFileSync}from"node:fs";import{createHash}from"node:crypto";const h=Object.fromEntries(readdirSync("current-audit/source").map(n=>[n,createHash("sha256").update(readFileSync("current-audit/source/"+n)).digest("hex")]));writeFileSync("current-audit/source-manifest.json",JSON.stringify(h));console.log("FOLLOW_SOURCE_INPUT "+JSON.stringify(h))'; bun current-audit/validate-tools.ts current-audit .
